sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Al–Bi binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset AlBi-06Kim.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, L1 → (Al) + L2, lies at 658.6 °C.
The Al–Bi system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as miscibility gap, monotectic.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry (Hallstedt, 2025), which reproduces the assessment of S.S. Kim, T.H. Sanders, Jr., Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng., 14, 1181-88(2006).
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
The dataset places a monotectic (L1 → (Al) + L2) at 658.6 °C; the composition of L1 is x(Bi) = 0.003.
Eutectic equilibrium L → (Al) + (Bi) is found at 271.2 °C and a mole fraction of 0.999 (L).
At 1400 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its maximum, 19.17 kJ/mol, at x(Bi) = 0.440.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
